name: Project Beta
description: An internal analytics dashboard for tracking business metrics and KPIs.
setup_instructions:
1. Clone the repository
2. Create virtual environment: `python -m venv venv`
3. Activate: `source venv/bin/activate` (Unix) or `venv\Scripts\activate` (Windows)
4. Install dependencies: `pip install -r requirements.txt`
5. Run migrations: `python manage.py migrate`
6. Start server: `python manage.py runserver`
onboarding_notes: This project uses Django REST framework for the API. Familiarize yourself with the data models in models.py before making changes.
